content: {"episode_id": "ep-05084", "cpt": "93271", "denial_carc": "CO-97", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
